popularity.title: Most-bought products
popularity.description: ranks every product by how many customers bought it; no personalisation

als_cf.title: ALS collaborative filtering
als_cf.description: latent factors from who bought what; a purchase weighs 1 + rating; 64 factors, 20 iterations

svd_mf.title: SVD matrix factorisation
svd_mf.description: truncated SVD of the explicit rating matrix, 50 factors

apriori_rules.title: Apriori association rules
apriori_rules.description: frequent product pairs (support 0.006, top-2 000 products) as rules scored by lift x confidence

adamic_adar.title: Adamic-Adar link prediction
adamic_adar.description: co-buyer paths through the customer-product graph, weighted 1 / log(degree)

naive_bayes.title: Naive Bayes over the purchase history
naive_bayes.description: multinomial naive Bayes, bought products as features, the 500 most-bought products as classes

bm25_text.title: BM25 keyword search
bm25_text.description: the customer's 200 most frequent review words (lemmatised in Czech) against product title, category and description

dense_e5.title: Dense multilingual retrieval (e5)
dense_e5.description: multilingual-e5-base vectors of product texts; a customer is the mean of the products bought; cosine similarity

bert_encoder.title: BERT encoders as recommenders
bert_encoder.description: [CLS] vectors of product texts from DistilBERT (en) or Czert-B (cs), no fine-tuning; cosine to the customer's mean vector

hybrid_als_dense.title: ALS + dense hybrid
hybrid_als_dense.description: equal-weight sum of per-customer min-max scaled ALS and dense-retrieval scores

lightgbm_features.title: LightGBM on engineered features
lightgbm_features.description: boosted trees, bought-or-not, over category, price, length and history-overlap features

svm_features.title: Linear SVM on engineered features
svm_features.description: linear SVM, bought-or-not, over the same features as the LightGBM arm

leave_one_out: last review by date, ties on the last day broken by the lowest review id
czech_branch: same customers, histories and hidden items; review text, headline and product title in Czech (title for 16 067 of 18 213 products, empty text for 3 207 untranslated reviews); descriptions stay English (D-UC04-D)
